nodes.label: D-CFR (Differential CFR on amplitudes)
nodes.rationale: Differencing removes offset exactly but turns linear tilt into a constant that Pearson ignores and Euclidean k-NN does not; costs ~2x per-subcarrier noise variance. No paper owns D-CFR.

nodes.label: Device heterogeneity mitigation (within-window z-score)
nodes.rationale: Z-scoring 4 anchor RSSIs within a window cancels device gain offset, dB analogue of Kjaergaard ratio fingerprints.

nodes.label: ADR-0003 calibration/evaluation protocol
nodes.rationale: Horus is direct precedent: off-grid held-out test points, different persons/days; cite RADAR TR for drift and Haeberlen/Kjaergaard for device diversity.

nodes.label: k-NN baseline (k~3, z-scored RSSI + D-CFR)
nodes.rationale: k=3 is RADAR-standard; equal block weight undefined and lets 200-dim D-CFR dominate 4-dim RSSI ~50:1; scale blocks by 1/sqrt(dim); within-window z-score needed for device-gain removal.

nodes.label: MDN scout
nodes.rationale: Matches Bishop 1994; bbox-centre fallback suffers multimodal-mean problem; use most probable kernel mean or mixture mode.

nodes.label: rx_ctrl.noise_floor / SNR floor
nodes.rationale: An SNR floor (rssi - noise_floor) transfers across rooms better than absolute -80 dBm; requires firmware to emit noise_floor.

nodes.label: Particle filter with w = prod exp(rho/sigma)
nodes.norm_label: particle filter with w = prod exp(rho/sigma)
nodes.rationale: Exponentiated form is a design choice (softmax over summed rho with temperature sigma); product-of-rho has precedent in FILA.

nodes.label: Product of per-anchor Pearson correlation
nodes.rationale: FILA Eq.10-11 fuses per-AP Pearson rho of normalized CSI spectra as a product; precedent for PF weight.

nodes.label: Per-packet L2 amplitude normalization
nodes.rationale: Justified by ESP32 auto-scaled CSI buffer (manu_scale=false); Pearson on raw normalized amplitude already ignores scale and offset.

nodes.label: Thresholds (rho>=0.6, -80 dBm, >=3 Records)
nodes.rationale: Data-driven only from 2026-08-28 capture; no primary source; FILA K=3 APs matches min_anchors=3.

nodes.label: Multi-anchor SIFS-timing attribution of ACK
nodes.rationale: ACK carries only RA (the eliciting node); other anchors must pair frame-to-T at t with ACK at t+10us via rx_ctrl.timestamp; biggest unproven risk.

nodes.label: Polite WiFi (Abedi & Abari, HotNets '20)
nodes.rationale: Every WiFi PHY ACKs a unicast frame addressed to its MAC within SIFS (10 us at 2.4 GHz), before it could verify/decrypt; tested on 5,328 devices; implemented on ESP32 because ESP32 reads CSI at legacy OFDM rates.

nodes.label: Vanhoef et al., Why MAC Address Randomization is not Enough (AsiaCCS '16)
nodes.norm_label: vanhoef et al., why mac address randomization is not enough (asiaccs '16)

nodes.label: Forced legacy OFDM 6 Mbps TX rate
nodes.norm_label: forced legacy ofdm 6 mbps tx rate
nodes.rationale: Forcing OFDM elicitation makes ACK return at legacy OFDM rate carrying L-LTF so ESP32 can produce CSI.

nodes.label: Dedicated illuminator node
nodes.rationale: ESP32 is half-duplex; one transmitter provokes ACKs while four anchors stay pure listeners.

nodes.label: Passive sniffer mesh framing
nodes.rationale: Any elicitation means the mesh transmits, so the system becomes active non-cooperative; options A (stay passive, Lumos-style) or B (adopt active, relabel).

nodes.label: ESP-NOW channel capacity (~214 kbps at 1 Mbps)
nodes.norm_label: esp-now channel capacity (~214 kbps at 1 mbps)
nodes.rationale: 4 anchors x 100-300 frames/s x 149-byte records needs 0.5-1.4 Mbit/s, far above measured ESP-NOW throughput; raise PHY rate or filter by target MAC.

nodes.label: Modem sleep pitfall (WIFI_PS_MIN_MODEM)
nodes.rationale: STA relay connected to AP may miss ESP-NOW frames under default modem sleep; add WiFi.setSleep(false); SoftAP does not sleep.

nodes.label: Single-radio single-channel rule
nodes.rationale: Anchors, Relay ESP-NOW RX, Relay uplink and target must share one 2.4 GHz channel in either design.

nodes.label: SoftAP Relay design (AP+STA, STA idle)
nodes.rationale: SoftAP works: ESP-NOW supported on AP interface, app pins channel, laptop joins and gets UDP; removes travel router, avoids STA modem-sleep pitfall, one fewer airtime hop.

nodes.label: Unicast UDP to laptop
nodes.rationale: AP does not buffer multicast for sleeping STAs; unicast avoids loss.

nodes.label: ADR for passive -> hybrid
nodes.rationale: Changes core architectural stance, hard to reverse, interacts with #13.

nodes.label: Hybrid rate-gated active-probe mode
nodes.rationale: Keep passive default; trigger one-node forced-OFDM null-data probing at ~100-150/s when a tracked MAC's passive frame rate falls below threshold; cannot rescue deep sleep/TWT or off-channel devices.

nodes.label: Capture window starvation
nodes.rationale: Passive mesh only captures when target transmits on our channel; power-save, TWT and scanning devices starve the >=30 windows requirement.

nodes.rationale: Every later hop depends on earlier ones and failures further down look like silence

nodes.description: Parse Captures -> windows -> RSSI smoothing, CSI normalization, D-CFR

nodes.label: D-CFR (differenced CFR amplitude)
nodes.rationale: L2 normalization removes scale, differencing removes offset and turns tilt into a constant that Pearson ignores; cost is doubled noise variance; not CFO/SFO cancellation

nodes.label: Within-window D-CFR stability (median pairwise Pearson rho)
nodes.norm_label: within-window d-cfr stability (median pairwise pearson rho)

nodes.label: k-NN baseline (k=3, IDW)
nodes.rationale: RADAR setting; RSSI z-scored within window across Anchors to cancel per-device gain; RSSI and D-CFR blocks equally weighted by 1/sqrt(dim); D-CFR mean-centred per Anchor for tilt invariance

nodes.label: Cross-device Trial
nodes.rationale: Same-vs-cross-device error gap reported as a result, not averaged away

nodes.label: Fallback rule (Sniper-ready Anchors)
nodes.rationale: >=3 valid CSI Records, stability >=0.6, RSSI > -80 dBm, at least min_anchors ready; thresholds anchored to 2026-08-28 capture gap between ~0.75 and ~0.1 stability

nodes.label: Offline-first localizers over windows.jsonl
nodes.rationale: Localizers run over preprocessed windows; streaming is a later ticket once offline numbers exist

nodes.label: Laptop as Gateway (Raspberry Pi retired)
nodes.rationale: Relay uplinks over WiFi UDP so laptop receives Captures directly; the Pi added a device, SSH setup and sync loop for nothing

nodes.label: Held-out Test positions P1-P10
nodes.rationale: Off-grid, never Reference points, so k-NN cannot score by coincidence (Horus protocol)

nodes.label: Calibration and test on separate days
nodes.norm_label: calibration and test on separate days
nodes.rationale: Radio map drift is inside the measurement, not excluded; >=3 Trials per Test position, >=30 sufficient windows

nodes.label: Sniper

nodes.label: MDN Scout (K=3 diagonal Gaussians)
nodes.rationale: Estimate is mean of most probable kernel, not mixture mean, because Bishop warns a multimodal mixture mean can fall between modes

nodes.label: Particle-filter Sniper (w = prod exp(rho/sigma))
nodes.rationale: Per-Anchor Pearson product follows FILA; exp(rho/sigma) is this work's surrogate; resampling across windows tightens estimate for stationary target

nodes.rationale: ESP-NOW default 1 Mbps DSSS has no OFDM training field so no CSI; forcing HT MCS0 and broadcast gives CSI on every frame at a steady unacked rate.

nodes.rationale: Fallback estimate is mean of most probable kernel, not bbox centre, because a multimodal mixture's centre can land between modes; bbox area threshold fixed at <60% of room.

nodes.label: relay_mac / ignore_macs CSI callback filter
nodes.rationale: Relay's own UDP frames were 98% of first wireless Capture; dropping in csi_rx_cb recovers ESP-NOW airtime which gateway-side filtering cannot.

nodes.label: Combined firmware: CSI callback yields whole tuple
nodes.norm_label: combined firmware: csi callback yields whole tuple
nodes.rationale: wifi_csi_info_t carries MAC + RSSI + timestamp + CSI for the same packet, so one callback produces the full (id,t,RSSI,CSI,anchor) tuple.

nodes.label: No on-device MAC filtering (gateway classifies)
nodes.rationale: Gateway performs wanted/unwanted classification and D-CFR, keeping the ESP32 firmware deliberately dumb.

nodes.label: Drop corrupt subcarrier +1 (drop_first_pos / --keep-first-subcarrier)
nodes.rationale: Real data showed hardware index 1 reads ~3 vs ~25 neighbours (first_word_invalid), so default drops it: 51 usable subcarriers -> 50 D-CFR.

nodes.label: 921600 to 115200 baud standardization
nodes.rationale: CH340-class USB-serial bridge drops bytes at 921600 causing esptool flash failure and garbled serial; 115200 adequate since wireless is the primary link.

nodes.label: Image-source CSI model (reflection_order 4, phase_wavelength_m 8)
nodes.rationale: First-order reflections gave flat CSI (stability ~0.1); baseband-only phase made fingerprints identical. Higher reflection order and effective wavelength are modelling knobs, not physics.

nodes.label: Missing-Anchor floor imputation after z-scoring
nodes.rationale: ADR-0002 z-scores present Anchors only; imputed value is min(-80 dBm, weakest present) so a missing Anchor never looks stronger than a heard one.

nodes.label: Keep 0.6 stability threshold; --min-stability 0 on sim
nodes.rationale: No simulated window is Sniper-ready at 0.6 (sim stability 0.13-0.35 vs real ~0.75); threshold stays sized on real Captures until sim CSI noise is recalibrated.
